name: github-dependency-scan-check
description: Judges whether an organisation's GitHub repositories scan their dependencies in Actions workflows that run on pull requests or pushes, from a reader's evidence. Fixed rules; calls nothing.

ACCEPTED.description: Findings the owner decided are acceptable, each written "rule:severity:subject" exactly as the check reported it. An accepted finding is reported as accepted, never dropped.

CATALOGUE_ONLY.description: Return the check's catalogue (every rule, its severity, task, remedy, limits and the published source it rests on) and judge nothing.
